# SOP-P2-L2-03 First-article inspection - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Purpose
1. Define the first-article inspection (FAI) procedure for ring forgings produced on the Ring Rolling line. Follow this SOP for all first-article lots prior to production release.

Preconditions
2. Material and heat number must be verified against order documentation.  
3. Process ECN verification: see ECN-2026-012 and ECN-2026-028 for recent process changes.  
4. Machine preventive maintenance complete and documented in SB-1017.

PPE
5. Required PPE for FAI personnel: safety glasses, leather gloves, hearing protection, and steel-toe footwear.

Inspection steps
6. Prepare the ring on EQ-P2-L2-IH01 per handling protocol; move to EQ-P2-L2-HT02 for specified heat treat cycle. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 16 seconds. Record actual delay time on the inspection checklist.  
7. Transfer ring to EQ-P2-L2-RR03 for rolling verification. The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 1525 mm. Measure and record outer diameter using calibrated equipment.  
8. Perform dimensional and visual checks per the first-article checklist. Note any deviations and hold parts if tolerance criteria are not met. Refer to ECN-2026-012 for dimensional tolerance updates.

Nonconformance
9. If any measured value is outside acceptance criteria, tag part as hold and notify Quality Engineering. Initiate disposition per SB-1017.

Documentation
10. Complete the FAI report and attach measurement records, furnace logs, and transfer records. Cite ECN-2026-028 where process deviations impacted rolling parameters.

Sign-off
11. Inspector: ____________________ Date: __________  
12. Quality Engineer: ____________________ Date: __________  
13. Production Lead: ____________________ Date: __________

Related documents: ECN-2026-012, ECN-2026-028, SB-1017
